tools.name: addToCart
tools.description: Add a product to the customer's cart. Call getProductDetails first if you don't already have the product's slug (and variationId, for products with variations).

variationId.description: For products with variations (size/color/etc.), the specific variation id from getProductDetails. Omit for simple products.

quantity.description: How many to add. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: browseCategory
tools.description: List products in a GoBike category, or navigate the browser to that category page. Use navigate=true when the user asks to be taken to/shown a category; omit categorySlug to browse everything.

categorySlug.description: Category slug from listProductCategories. Omit to list all active products.

navigate.description: When true, moves the browser to the category page instead of returning product data. Defaults to false.

tools.name: emptyCart
tools.description: Remove every item from the customer's cart.

tools.name: getCart
tools.description: Get the current shopping cart's contents — line items with product name, quantity, price, and totals.

tools.name: getProductDetails
tools.description: Get full details (price, stock, description, rating, variations) for one GoBike product by its URL slug, or navigate the browser to its product page.

slug.description: The product's URL slug, e.g. "gobike-16-inch-electric-balance-bike" — from searchProducts' or browseCategory's results

navigate.description: When true, moves the browser to the product page instead of returning product data. Defaults to false.

tools.name: listProductCategories
tools.description: List GoBike Australia's product categories (bike sizes, spare parts, apparel) available in the shop.

tools.name: proceedToCheckout
tools.description: Navigate the browser to checkout with the customer's current cart. Does not place the order — the customer completes payment themselves on the checkout page.

tools.name: searchProducts
tools.description: Search GoBike Australia's product catalog (kids electric bikes, spare parts, apparel) by keyword.

query.description: Search keywords, e.g. "16 inch battery" or "kids electric bike"

tools.name: searchShopPoliciesAndFaqs
tools.description: Get facts about GoBike's policies, FAQs, or contact details. Set policyTypes to fetch a specific policy page (refund, shipping, privacy, terms_of_service, contact, warranty); leave it unset for general FAQ questions.

query.description: A natural-language question. Searches FAQ questions/answers by keyword when policyTypes is omitted.

policyTypes.description: Policy page(s) to fetch directly instead of searching FAQs, e.g. ["refund"] for "what is your return policy".

tools.name: subscribeNewsletter
tools.description: Subscribe an email address to the GoBike Australia newsletter and giveaway

tools.name: trackOrder
tools.description: Check a GoBike order's delivery status by Booking ID and delivery postcode (both required — same verification the public tracking page uses).

bookingId.description: The numeric Booking ID from the order confirmation email

postcode.description: The delivery postcode, used to verify the requester owns this order

tools.name: updateCartLine
tools.description: Change the quantity of an item already in the cart, or remove it. Get the item's key from getCart first.

key.description: The cart line key from getCart

quantity.description: New absolute quantity for this line (not a delta). 0 removes the item.

tools.name: viewOrderHistory
tools.description: Navigate the browser to the customer's order history. Prompts sign-in first if they aren't already logged in.
